adopted: Finding: statistics and named sources raise AI-answer visibility, so a post with verified facts must state at least one verified figure (NO_VERIFIED_FIGURE) and name Ken Research next to a finding (NO_ATTRIBUTION)
Finding: fluent prose helps, so long and choppy sentences are flagged (LONG_SENTENCE, CHOPPY_SENTENCES)
Finding: keyword stuffing hurts (-8.7%), so it is never used and repeated lead-in phrases fail (REPEATED_PHRASE)
Where a general claim can be replaced by one of the verified figures, use the figure and name Ken Research next to it in the same sentence.
Write fluent sentences: join runs of very short sentences, and split any sentence that runs past about 35 words.
Never repeat a keyword or a stock lead-in phrase across points; vary the wording of each point.
